lead.note: **168 River Junction (Withlacoochee SF)** — ReserveAmerica marks sites 001, 014, 016 "Near Water"; entry and the --AWH note say not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: Firsthand manual audit by owner (--AWH note); waterfront 'not waterfront' per owner: Campground is reported to be quiet and peaceful with a nice sandy beach on the Withalacochee River; campsites are not waterfront.

lead.note: **14387 Panhandle RV Resort** (minor) — "Two Fishing Ponds ... right on the property".
lead.prior_evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 30.4365,-85.3423: compact gravel loops south of FL-20 in cleared pine flatwoods; two small ponds sit off the loop edges, not at the rows - not waterfront

lead.note: **14870 Seminole Campground** — "47 creek side campsites" on Pop Ash Creek; entry not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 26.7205,-81.8109: RV loops under oak/pine canopy; Popash Creek runs through the woods and can't be seen at any pad; the lake to the west is beyond the park's treeline and a track - not waterfront (canopy-blind, defaults down)

lead.note: **14434 Scott's Ferry** (weak) — "Located on the Chipola River with boat launch"; entry not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite (Esri, 260 m frame) at 30.2884,-85.1445: RV sites on open grass ~55 m east of the Chipola River, with the campground loop road and a continuous strip of bank trees between them and the water; only the dock and boat launch reach the river (operator map agrees) - not waterfront; riverview candidate if a leaf-on sightline is ever confirmed
